correctness.rationale: The universal hub is active at time zero if seeded or after the first synchronous round otherwise. Then a peripheral component activates completely iff it contains a seed: hub + active periphery propagate along internal edges, untouched components cannot start with only their hub neighbor. Classifying unordered seed pairs gives exact PGF: within component or hub+component contributes C(s_i+1,2) z^(s_i+1), seeds in two components contribute s_i s_j z^(s_i+s_j+1), all divided C(n,2). Summing hit indicators yields mean 1+Σ s_i²(2n−1−s_i)/[n(n−1)]. The feasible two-block transfer derivative (a−b+2t)[4n−2−3(a+b)]/[n(n−1)]>0 proves strict concentration. Degree and triangle counts for fan vs disconnected triangle-plus-path periphery match as stated for all n≥6. Independently enumerated ALL connected labelled simple graphs for n=2..5 (1,4,38,728) with exact rational two-seed cascades, ruling out smaller reversal; independently checked n=6 has means 6 and 23/5, with triangle counts 4 and 5. Finite enumeration is exhaustive ONLY for n≤5; infinite family is proved symbolically.
